display.purpose: The canvas-rendered hero word and its stable fallback.

headline.purpose: The supporting phrase above the interactive display word.

headline-result.purpose: The conversion-oriented phrase beneath the interactive display word.

mobile-headline.purpose: The opening hero phrase on phone and tablet layouts.

mobile-headline-result.purpose: The right-aligned result phrase below the interactive mobile word.

mobile-body.purpose: The compact mobile hero value statement.

mobile-label.purpose: Uppercase labels for the two mobile hero actions.

motion.name: hierarchy-entrance
motion.purpose: A 0.72-second fade-and-rise entrance for the responsive hero headline, conversion block, and capability note.

motion.name: button-radial-fill
motion.purpose: Expands the CTA fill from pointer location or keyboard-focus center.

motion.name: live-type-return
motion.purpose: Returns a displaced glyph with stiffness 320 and damping 22.

motion.name: live-type-sweep
motion.purpose: Runs the autonomous technical sweep on fine pointers only; coarse pointers and reduced motion keep it disabled.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The dominant Contact Us action across the responsive hero, with an ink fill response.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 50px; overflow: hidden; padding: 0.82rem 1rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #CD0000; color: #EFEDE6; font-family: Inter, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(0.72rem, 3vw, 0.82rem); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms ease, color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary-fill { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: 160%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: #151412; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0); transition: transform 500ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary-label { position: relative; z-index: 1; } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-btn-primary-fill, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible .ds-btn-primary-fill { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #CD0000; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } @media (min-width: 1024px) { .ds-btn-primary { min-width: 13rem; min-height: 58px; padding: 1rem 1.8rem; font-size: 0.88rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-primary, .ds-btn-primary-fill { transition: none; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: none; } }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The quieter View Our Work action across the responsive hero, with a red fill response.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 50px; overflow: hidden; padding: 0.82rem 1rem; border: 1px solid rgba(21,20,18,0.34); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(239,237,230,0.86); color: #151412; font-family: Inter, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(0.72rem, 3vw, 0.82rem); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms ease, color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary-fill { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: 160%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: #CD0000; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0); transition: transform 500ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary-label { position: relative; z-index: 1; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover, .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { color: #EFEDE6; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover .ds-btn-secondary-fill, .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible .ds-btn-secondary-fill { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #CD0000; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } @media (min-width: 1024px) { .ds-btn-secondary { min-width: 12rem; min-height: 58px; padding: 1rem 1.8rem; background: rgba(239,237,230,0.82); font-size: 0.88rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-secondary, .ds-btn-secondary-fill { transition: none; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: none; } }

components.name: Live Type Selection
components.description: A static preview of the responsive TechText glyph frame; production touch preserves pan-y, supports direct drag, and disables autonomous sweep on coarse pointers.
components.html: WEBS206 × 248ITES
components.css: .ds-live-type { display: flex; align-items: baseline; padding: 3rem 1rem 1rem; overflow: hidden; background: #EFEDE6; color: #151412; font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(3.5rem, 10vw, 8rem); font-weight: 700; line-height: 0.8; letter-spacing: -0.04em; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-live-type-selected { position: relative; display: inline-block; outline: 1px dashed #CD0000; outline-offset: 0.08em; } .ds-live-type-size { position: absolute; left: -0.08em; top: -2.2em; color: #CD0000; font-family: Inter, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-live-type-handle { position: absolute; width: 7px; height: 7px; border: 1px solid #CD0000; background: #EFEDE6; } .ds-live-type-tl { left: -0.11em; top: -0.11em; } .ds-live-type-tr { right: -0.11em; top: -0.11em; } .ds-live-type-br { right: -0.11em; bottom: -0.11em; } .ds-live-type-bl { left: -0.11em; bottom: -0.11em; }

components.name: Atelier Proof Surface
components.description: The static responsive warm-white proof field with breakpoint-tuned dots and diagonal red light.
components.css: .ds-proof-surface { position: relative; min-height: 220px; overflow: hidden; background: radial-gradient(70% 82% at 10% 8%, rgba(255,255,255,0.72), transparent 66%), radial-gradient(55% 70% at 96% 4%, rgba(205,0,0,0.12), transparent 72%), linear-gradient(112deg, #EFEDE6 0%, #E9E5DD 58%, #EFEDE6 100%); color: #151412; isolation: isolate; } .ds-proof-surface::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -60% -10%; z-index: -1; opacity: 0.72; background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0%, rgba(205,0,0,0.08) 28%, rgba(205,0,0,0.9) 48%, rgba(205,0,0,0.24) 63%, transparent 82%); transform: rotate(-43deg) scaleX(0.16); } .ds-proof-surface::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; opacity: 0.42; background-image: radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px, rgba(21,20,18,0.26) 1px, transparent 0); background-size: 20px 20px; mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, #000, transparent); } .ds-proof-surface-label { position: absolute; left: 5%; bottom: 12%; font-family: Inter, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Capability Annotation
components.description: A quiet factual note that balances the lower-right on desktop and bottom-right on mobile when height permits.
components.css: .ds-capability { width: 10rem; margin: 0; padding-left: 1rem; border-left: 1px solid rgba(21,20,18,0.32); color: rgba(21,20,18,0.72); font-family: Inter, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.45; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-align: left; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview:
Flevio's hero is a warm-white technical proof surface where oversized type behaves like crafted material rather than a marketing ornament. Cherry-red light fields, sparse construction marks, and deliberate negative space make the experience premium, precise, confident, and experimental without obscuring the conversion path.

The system demonstrates the product promise: custom design and hand-coded development are visible in the interface itself. Its signature is a code-drawn selection frame that turns typography into evidence of craft; supporting copy and controls stay restrained so that the proof remains legible.

This is currently a scoped new world, not a completed site-wide rollout. It is authoritative for the complete hero: the approved desktop composition at 1024px and above and its responsive mobile adaptation through 1023px. All later incumbent sections retain their existing visual system until explicitly redesigned; do not silently retrofit them from this document.
keyCharacteristics: Cherry-red skewed light fields used with restraint
Oversized editorial typography with strong negative space
Sparse technical annotations and selection geometry
Interaction as evidence of custom, hand-coded craft
Responsive mobile composition with static, performant atmosphere
English and Georgian layouts tuned independently where required
Clear conversion hierarchy for international service businesses

rules.name: The Red-as-Evidence Rule
rules.body: Cherry Red marks authored interaction, decisive action, or directional light; it is not general-purpose decoration.

rules.name: The Transitional Scope Rule
rules.body: Apply this palette to the responsive hero only until another surface is explicitly redesigned into the same world.

rules.name: The Type-Is-the-Proof Rule
rules.body: The largest type must demonstrate bespoke craft through scale, fit, or interaction; never reduce it to a generic centered headline treatment.

rules.name: The Wide-Statement Rule
rules.body: Keep primary display phrases broad and shallow. Do not force the headline into narrow, multi-line text blocks.

rules.name: The One-Viewport Rule
rules.body: The hero must fit inside one viewport at every supported width and must not create overflow below its boundary.

rules.name: The Responsive Atelier Rule
rules.body: Keep one visual world across the 1024px boundary while changing its composition: mobile is a deliberate vertical adaptation, and desktop retains its established asymmetric arrangement.

rules.name: The Light-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Create atmosphere with directional color fields and tonal layering; do not add card shadows or floating glass panels to the hero.

rules.name: The Geometry Contrast Rule
rules.body: Use hard-edged construction geometry around type and soft pill geometry for controls so interaction and evidence remain visually distinct.

dos: Do use Warm White as the dominant hero field and reserve Cherry Red for light, action, focus, and technical evidence.
Do keep the oversized headline immediately readable before and during interaction.
Do preserve the primary Contact Us action and the secondary View Our Work action as a clear conversion pair on mobile and desktop.
Do use the established `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` hierarchy entrance and provide reduced-motion fallbacks.
Do preserve English and Georgian layouts, including language-specific mobile headline sizing.
Do keep mobile background atmosphere static and disable autonomous TechText sweep on coarse pointers.
donts: Don't turn the system into a generic centered agency template.
Don't use Cherry Red as ambient decoration without an interaction, hierarchy, or directional-light purpose.
Don't animate the mobile background or enable automatic TechText sweep on coarse-pointer devices.
Don't let the oversized TechText canvas escape the hero's local clipping boundary.
Don't claim that incumbent sections below the hero already use the Live Type Atelier world.
Don't fabricate testimonials, performance claims, or business results as visual proof.
